title: Giza pink granite hauled 500 miles from Aswan

place_text: Giza Plateau and Aswan quarry, Egypt

tellings.quote: all the pink GR it we find throughout the Giza Plateau came from 500 miles away to the south in the Awan Quarry

plain: A researcher named Matt LaCroix, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says all the pink granite found across the Giza Plateau in Egypt, where the great pyramids stand, came from the Aswan quarry about 500 miles to the south. He tells it to show the huge effort the ancient builders would have needed to move such heavy stone so far.
